note: Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"laws" is anchored on sc:statement (a required conjunct), not sc:lawId -- the anchor's
blind spot must not be the join key the whole pack pivots on.
"covers" emits one row per sc:covers edge, so VALUES on the edge predicate.
